name: Saint Fang

generalAbilities.name: Forge Vision
generalAbilities.description: Saint Fang ignores the Concealed condition from smoke and fire.

savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Buck
defensiveAbilities.description:
DC 37 Reflex Saving Throw

See rules...

Most monsters that serve as mounts can attempt to buck off unwanted or annoying riders, but most mounts will not use this reaction against a trusted creature unless the mounts are spooked or mistreated.

Trigger A creature Mounts or uses the Command an Animal action while riding the monster.

Effect The triggering creature must succeed at a Reflex saving throw against the listed DC or fall off the creature and land Prone. If the save is a critical failure, the triggering creature also takes 1d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage in addition to the normal damage for the fall.

defensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
90 feet DC 37 Will Saving Throw

See rules...

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Spiked Scales
defensiveAbilities.description: A creature that critically fails to Strike Saint Fang in melee takes 6d6 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Wing Deflection
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Saint Fang is targeted with an attack

Effect Saint Fang raises a wing, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If he is flying, he descends 10 feet after the attack is complete.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: Saint Fang makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description: When Saint Fang scores a critical hit with a Strike, he recharges his Dragon Breath.

offensiveAbilities.name: Dragon Breath
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saint Fang breathes in one of two ways. He can't use Dragon Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

Blade Breath (arcane) He breathes a 100ft Line of sharp blades that deals 19d6 Slashing Damage damage (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save). The blades created by this breath vanish at the end of the round.

Forge Breath (arcane) He breathes a blast of embers and smoke, as if from an immense forge. Each creature within a 40ft Cone takes 6d6 Fire Damage|options:area-damage]{6d6 fire damage and 12d6 poison damage} (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save). Smoke lingers in the area until the end of Saint Fang's next turn; all creatures within the smoke become Concealed, and all creatures outside the smoke become concealed to creatures within.
